# Checks: what holds each rule

**Kind:** Reference
**Status:** Built (F149); generated by `tools/impact.py docs` from `tools/impact.toml`, never edited by hand

Every check the repository has, when it runs and what it catches and
misses; every rule of the registry by area, with what holds it; and
the parts of the suite that read the repository's paths. `just lint`
fails while this file differs from the registry. The reasons are
`docs/IMPACT.md`'s and `docs/decisions/F149.md`'s; which tool or lint
does what is `tools/README.md`'s.

## 3. Review only

No script holds these; a reviewer reads this list for the change.

| Rule | Source |
|---|---|
| `repo.build-machine-unnamed`: the remote build machine is "the build machine" in docs, comments and messages, never its hostname, owner or address | `CLAUDE.md` |
| `repo.personal-information`: every new commit's diff and message checked for names, addresses, hostnames, local paths, keys and tokens before a push | `CLAUDE.md` |
| `repo.contributing`: CONTRIBUTING.md's summary follows CLAUDE.md's rules | `CONTRIBUTING.md` |
| `repo.tests-kept`: a test is changed to the rule it now encodes, never deleted to make the build pass | `CLAUDE.md` |
| `repo.tests-user-facing`: a test covers user-facing behaviour or a published vector; none states a design rule, a token's value or a screen's geometry against a document | `CLAUDE.md` |
| `tree.image-metadata`: an image or PDF carries no metadata | `tools/README.md` |
| `standards.what-goes-in`: what the app takes in is a published standard checked against another implementation, or Faraday's own rule that fails closed | `docs/STANDARDS.md` §0 |
| `standards.refusals-stay`: what the code refuses stays refused; accepting more than a standard requires is a decision | `CLAUDE.md`<br>`docs/decisions/F90.md` |
| `standards.no-way-past`: a check that keeps keys or money safe has no way past it unless a decision names the case; a hold names it | `CLAUDE.md`<br>`docs/decisions/F136.md` |
| `standards.out-of-app`: unpublished or unreviewed work stays in the repository, compiled out of the app | `docs/STANDARDS.md` §0<br>`docs/decisions/F109.md` |
| `standards.scope`: a new kind of key or signature is a decision | `docs/decisions/F116.md` |
| `crypto.independence-said`: no text calls a check outside where the implementation it compares with is Faraday's own, or calls such a check not independent: it is not checked against an outside source | `docs/decisions/F160.md`<br>`docs/decisions/F177.md`<br>`docs/decisions/F179.md` |
| `crypto.tested`: a cryptographic change is tested against published vectors or another implementation | `CLAUDE.md`<br>`docs/decisions/F148.md` |
| `crypto.at-source`: core/ is Faraday's own code: a thing is fixed at its source rather than wrapped | `CLAUDE.md` |
| `crypto.kept-values`: a type re-implemented from a core/ one keeps the values the original works out once | `CLAUDE.md` |
| `crypto.costs-said`: a function that costs more than a lookup says "Costs" in the first line of its doc | `CLAUDE.md` |
| `keys.secret-files`: a file that starts to hold secrets is added to lint-secrets' SECRET_FILES | `tools/README.md` |
| `keys.child-vault-only`: that a seed is a BIP-85 child of another is kept only in a vault, and only when recorded; nothing written outside one says so, nor of a BIP-85 password | `docs/decisions/F166.md`<br>`docs/decisions/F172.md` |
| `keys.home-scan-takes-all`: a kind any scanner or form takes by QR, Home's Scan takes too and routes to its flow, scanned and pasted alike; a precondition is said in one line, or on the read card for a TOTP setup code with no vault open | `docs/decisions/F167.md`<br>`docs/decisions/F173.md` |
| `speed.kept-in-step`: a value kept on the state for drawing has its invariant written where it lives and a test that changes the source | `CLAUDE.md`<br>`docs/SPEED.md` §3 |
| `speed.late-flow-timed`: work added while drawing or after every event is timed in a late-flow session before it is committed | `CLAUDE.md`<br>`docs/SPEED.md` §7 |
| `structure.areas-private`: an area's state is a struct with private fields, reached through accessors and its own methods | `docs/STRUCTURE-PASS.md` §7 |
| `structure.vault-together`: the vault code is not split per screen (F170) | `docs/decisions/F170.md` |
| `strings.no-explanation`: a working screen carries labels, values and actions, never an explanation; Learn and About explain | `CLAUDE.md`<br>`docs/decisions/F112.md` |
| `strings.plain`: text anywhere in the product is plain statement of fact, never mannered prose | `CLAUDE.md`<br>`docs/DESIGN.md` §2 |
| `strings.medium`: the medium's words come from Medium; "SD card" where it is one | `docs/decisions/F4.md` |
| `design.left-out`: none of F111's left-out components is added | `docs/decisions/F111.md` |
| `design.demo-matches`: Faraday Demo differs from the device only by a decision | `docs/decisions/F117.md` |
| `design.maker-pages`: the Starter's maker pages show several families at once, no model, no maker's screenshot or name | `docs/decisions/F14.md`<br>`docs/decisions/F18.md` |
| `guide.pictures`: the guide's pictures are drawn again when a screen changes | `docs/GUIDE.md` |
| `deps.locked`: builds and checks pass --locked | `CLAUDE.md`<br>`docs/decisions/F71.md` |
| `fuzz.parser-target`: a parser of untrusted input has its fuzz target in the same change | `tools/README.md` |
| `release.before`: before a release: just, just crosscheck --fresh, the fuzz run and its corpus | `tools/README.md` |

| `website.standards`: the website's standards page | `docs/STANDARDS.md`<br>`docs/crypto/actions.toml`<br>`docs/crypto/gen.py`<br>`docs/crypto/gen_how.py`<br>`docs/CROSSCHECK.md`<br>`tools/crosscheck/README.md`<br>`tools/crosscheck/area_*.py`<br>`tools/reference/**/README.md`<br>`Cargo.lock`<br>`fuzz/README.md`<br>`fuzz/Cargo.toml`<br>`faraday/fuzz/Cargo.toml`<br>`justfile`<br>`docs/INTEROP.md`<br>`docs/deps/README.md`<br>`docs/AUDIT-SUBMISSIONS.md` | the page is generated again from the pinned STANDARDS, manifest and cross-check documents; a shape it does not know stops its build (docs/CRYPTO-LEARN.md §11) |
| `website.cryptography`: the website's /cryptography page | `docs/crypto/actions.toml`<br>`docs/crypto/gen.py`<br>`docs/crypto/gen_how.py`<br>`docs/CRYPTO-LEARN.md`<br>`tools/crosscheck/stamp`<br>`tools/crosscheck/area_*.py`<br>`Cargo.lock` | the page is generated again from the pinned manifest; a schema it does not know stops its build (docs/CRYPTO-LEARN.md §11.1) |
